sample_rows.summary: Invoice totals mismatch between Stripe charges and NetSuite journal entries for Summit Group
sample_rows.description: Nightly reconciliation run flags 14 Summit Group invoices where the Stripe charge total does not match the posted journal entry. Suspected dropped reversal webhook from the 2026-07-28 deploy.

sample_rows.summary: Automate the daily reconciliation export for the Riverside Group billing account
sample_rows.description: Replace the manual CSV pull with a scheduled export job so the recon dashboard picks up Riverside Group balances before the 09:00 close review.

sample_rows.summary: Recon dashboard: surface unmatched credit notes older than 30 days
sample_rows.description: Finance wants a dedicated panel listing credit notes that have not matched an invoice within 30 days, with account name and amount, so the close review can chase them down.

sample_rows.summary: Duplicate journal entries created when Meridian invoices are voided and reissued
sample_rows.description: Voiding and reissuing a Meridian invoice posts a second journal entry without reversing the first, inflating recognized revenue until the manual month-end correction.

sample_rows.summary: Backfill July FX rates for Harborview EUR invoices in the reconciliation run
sample_rows.description: Harborview EUR invoices reconciled against stale FX rates for the first week of July. Backfill the daily rates and re-run the matching job for the affected window.

sample_rows.summary: Dedupe merge: 43 duplicate contact records across Summit Group and Atlas accounts
sample_rows.description: The weekly dedupe scan found 43 duplicate contacts split across the Summit Group and Atlas account hierarchies. Merge per the dedupe race-handling rules, preserving activity history.

sample_rows.summary: Lead source field is blanked when an SDR converts a lead to an opportunity
sample_rows.description: Converting a lead wipes the lead_source value on the resulting opportunity, breaking campaign attribution. Reproduced on lead L-2214 (source Webinar FY2026).

sample_rows.summary: Enforce picklist values for the industry field on account create
sample_rows.description: Free-text industry values (27 spellings of Asset Management alone) break the data quality report. Enforce the standard picklist at create time and map legacy values.

sample_rows.summary: Weekly data quality report: stale opportunities past the stage-gate SLA
sample_rows.description: Ship the weekly report listing opportunities that exceeded the stale-opportunity ladder thresholds, grouped by owner, so sales managers can action them Monday morning.

sample_rows.summary: Deal desk approval queue: auto-route discounts over 20% to finance per CPQ policy
sample_rows.description: Per the CPQ discount policy, discounts above 20% need finance sign-off. Build the approval queue routing so those quotes land with finance instead of stalling in the deal desk inbox.

sample_rows.summary: Quote PDF generator drops the renewal term on multi-year Crestline deals
sample_rows.description: Multi-year Crestline quotes render without the renewal term clause, so legal bounces them. Blocked on a fix from the PDF template vendor; manual workaround in place.

sample_rows.summary: Add the Ironwood co-sell overlap check to the deal registration form
sample_rows.description: Deal registrations touching Ironwood must be checked against the co-sell and named-account overlap list before approval. Add the automated check to the registration form.

sample_rows.summary: Route inbound MQLs to the SDR queue by AUM band
sample_rows.description: Inbound MQLs should route to the SDR queue keyed on the account AUM band from the tiering standard, not raw revenue. Mei's queue is currently getting sub-band leads.

sample_rows.summary: Instrument funnel conversion events for FY2026 campaigns
sample_rows.description: Emit conversion events at each funnel stage for the FY2026 campaign set so the funnel conversion-rate report stops relying on the weekly manual export.

sample_rows.summary: Support ticket SLA timer keeps running after a ticket moves to Pending Client
sample_rows.description: The SLA timer should pause while a ticket sits in Pending Client, but it keeps accruing when the status change comes from automation rather than a manual move. Breaches are being reported incorrectly.

tools.name: jira_search
tools.description: Search for issues using a JQL-style text query matched against issue summary and description, with optional project, status, and assignee filters (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql)

jql.description: The JQL-style search text. Matched case-insensitively as a substring of the issue summary or description.

project.description: Restrict results to issues in the project with this project key, for example RECON.

status.description: Restrict results to issues currently in this status, for example In Progress.

assignee.description: Restrict results to issues assigned to this user. Accepts the display name or the email address.

max_results.description: The maximum number of issues to return per page. Default: 50.

start_at.description: The index of the first issue to return (0-based). Default: 0.

tools.name: jira_issue_get
tools.description: Returns the details for an issue, including status, priority, assignee, sprint, and labels (GET /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey})

issue_key.description: The ID or key of the issue, for example RECON-101.

tools.name: jira_issue_create
tools.description: Creates an issue in a project; the issue key is generated from the project key and the next sequence number (POST /rest/api/3/issue)

project_key.description: The key of the project the issue is created in, for example RECON. Returns a 404 if the project does not exist.

summary.description: A brief one-line summary of the issue.

issue_type.description: The name of the issue type, for example Bug, Task, or Story.

description.description: A detailed description of the issue.

priority.description: The name of the priority, for example Highest, High, Medium, Low. Default: Medium.

assignee.description: The display name of the user the issue is assigned to.

assignee_email.description: The email address of the assignee.

reporter.description: The display name of the user reporting the issue.

reporter_email.description: The email address of the reporter.

sprint_id.description: The ID of the sprint to place the issue in, if any.

labels.description: Comma-separated labels to apply to the issue, for example billing,reconciliation.

tools.custom_source:
def jira_issue_create(db_path='state.db', **kwargs):
    import sqlite3, datetime
    project_key = kwargs.get('project_key')
    summary = kwargs.get('summary')
    if not project_key or not summary:
        return {'error': 'project_key and summary are required', 'status': 400}
    issue_type = kwargs.get('issue_type') or 'Task'
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    proj = conn.execute('SELECT * FROM jira_projects WHERE key = ?', (project_key,)).fetchone()
    if proj is None:
        conn.close()
        return {'error': 'Project ' + str(project_key) + ' not found', 'status': 404}
    row = conn.execute('SELECT MAX(CAST(substr(key, length(?) + 2) AS INTEGER)) AS n FROM jira_issues WHERE project_key = ?', (project_key, project_key)).fetchone()
    next_num = (row['n'] or 100) + 1
    new_key = str(project_key) + '-' + str(next_num)
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000+0000')
    conn.execute('INSERT INTO jira_issues (key, summary, description, issue_type, status, priority, assignee, assignee_email, reporter, reporter_email, project_key, sprint_id, labels, created, updated) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)', (new_key, summary, kwargs.get('description') or '', issue_type, 'To Do', kwargs.get('priority') or 'Medium', kwargs.get('assignee'), kwargs.get('assignee_email'), kwargs.get('reporter'), kwargs.get('reporter_email'), project_key, kwargs.get('sprint_id'), kwargs.get('labels') or '', now, now))
    conn.commit()
    created = dict(conn.execute('SELECT * FROM jira_issues WHERE key = ?', (new_key,)).fetchone())
    conn.close()
    return created

issue_key.description: The ID or key of the issue to edit, for example RECON-101.

summary.description: The new one-line summary of the issue.

description.description: The new detailed description of the issue.

issue_type.description: The new issue type name, for example Bug, Task, or Story.

priority.description: The new priority name, for example Highest, High, Medium, Low.

labels.description: The full replacement comma-separated label list for the issue.
